observed_problem: Stripe-side success can outlive failed local persistence
audit writes can fail after model state is durable
some same-database parent/child operations can leave inconsistent durable states
world.contamination_note: Issue text itself suggests transactions, idempotency, rollback and reconciliation; therefore this is a weakly blinded implementation discriminator, not a clean discovery holdout.

prediction.core_invariant: durable state that is semantically invalid without a companion fact/effect needs closure across failure
prediction.moderator: whether all required effects share one transactional substrate
prediction.if_shared_transaction_available: expect one atomic commit/rollback boundary for invariant-coupled durable facts
prediction.if_remote_or_nontransactional_effect_exi: expect idempotency plus compensation/reconciliation/outbox-like recovery rather than pretending one local DB transaction can atomically cover the remote effect
prediction.negative_scope: notifications/analytics/other recoverable side effects that are not part of the validity invariant should remain outside the atomic closure

falsifiers: actual repair leaves invariant-coupled partial failures unaddressed and fixes the bug by an unrelated mechanism
remote+local effects are made genuinely atomic without compensation/idempotency/reconciliation
auxiliary non-invariant effects are unnecessarily pulled into the same closure and this is required for correctness
